description: 在页面上下文中（携带真实 cookie/origin）重新发送一个 HTTP 请求，可选改写 url/method/headers/body，并返回响应。用于端到端验证已复现的签名或参数：以通过 reqid 捕获的请求（来自 list_network_requests）为基础，覆盖其中的签名字段。

credentials.description: Fetch credentials mode (default: include — sends the page cookies).

headers.description: Header overrides merged over the captured headers.

maxBodyChars.description: Max response body characters to return (default: 4000).

method.description: HTTP method override (default: original or GET).

reqid.description: Base the replay on this captured request (from list_network_requests).

url.description: Request URL. Required without reqid; overrides the captured URL otherwise.

name: replay_request
